description: This file defines an abstract PHP class 'reqMgrSystemInterface' that provides a base for connecting to requirement management systems, including methods for configuration, connection management, and retrieving projects, baselines, and requirements.

classes.name: reqMgrSystemInterface
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface for requirement management system connections, meant to be extended for specific implementations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that sets configuration and initiates connection.

methods.name: setCfg
methods.description: Sets configuration from an XML string, parsing it into a SimpleXML object.

methods.name: getMyInterface
methods.description: Returns the interface PHP configuration value.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the system is connected.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to the requirement management system.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the requirement management system.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Retrieves list of projects from the system.

methods.name: getBaselines
methods.description: Retrieves baselines for a given project.

methods.name: getRequirements
methods.description: Retrieves requirements for a given project and baseline.
